PJECC

A full rebrand and launch for the Palisades Jewish Early Childhood Center, rebuilt after the fires and reopening for a new generation of families.

Client

Palisades Jewish Early Childhood Center

Services

Brand Messaging, Branding, Social Media, Marketing, Website Design

Year

2026

The Challenge

When the Palisades fires destroyed PJECC's original campus, this beloved early childhood center faced an emotional new chapter. They opened a second location to keep serving families, and set out to reopen their original Palisades home too. With branding that was more than 15 years old, they needed a fresh identity and message to carry the school into its next generation.

What We Created

We gave PJECC a warm, joyful rebrand from the ground up: a new visual identity and logo, fresh brand messaging, and a full suite of print and digital collateral. We designed the website, rolled out a social media campaign, and set the marketing direction to reintroduce the school to its community.

The Results

With two locations now open and a brand that reflects who they are today, PJECC is welcoming a new wave of families, with enrollment growing across both campuses.
